shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls residual-clamped + ledger-aware; ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).
- Needs-bridge doctrine: postfix the vanilla giver, keep any real local result, re-run the giver's own guard chain, probe linked levels virtually with the SAME vanilla finder, one-hop stairs job, giver re-fires on arrival; per-pawn fail cooldowns.

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier in pass 22 schematic + lore (biomes): water facts, three-signal detection, per-FACE hydrology, ExecuteLift machinery; UNSOLVED: per-stretch single-exit-face lips + braided-terrain seal.

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25)
- Pass 23: `Invoke(null)` on instance ShouldAutoRecharge → Logistics guard tripped per session. Fixed + demand fan-cap + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB orders.
- Pass 24: ferry discipline — in-flight ledger, residual clamps, onward demand hop.
- Pass 25: merge-kill fix (continuations target LANDED thing; mechs included) + bill-product cross-level continuation.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (pass 26 scan; P0 pass 27; P1 pass 28; P2 pass 29)

## Audit baseline (do not rebuild)
Work migration core (idle full-scan + better-work probes + emergency scan wired via JobGiver_Work postfix + robot variant) · full ferry stack · needs bridges · areas · counters/wealth/home/bonds/colonist bar/trade/caravans/power/pipes/weather · threats · mech suite · animal flows.

## P0 — UI TRUTH ✅ (pass 27)
Skill-warning dialog column-scoped (single sink; ITab_Bills + HealthCardUtility) · restriction dropdown AUDITED CLEAN · meal/defense/joy alerts column-union (joy TRUE kind union) · research bench + fire visibility AUDITED CLEAN. Deferred: lambda-buried RecipeRequiresMechanitor edge.

## P1 — EMERGENCY RESPONSIVENESS ✅ (pass 28)
IsPatient += pending surgery bills (busy surgeons probe-see operations) · Fire.SpawnSetup version bump (fresh Firefighter bit) · BillStack.AddBill bump + demand invalidate (instant probes + ingredient ferries; also fixes P4 #18 cadence). AUDITED ALREADY-BUILT: emergency wiring (fire/tend/downed), feed pulls (Doctor/Warden/Childcare bits + meal ferries), flick re-arm (AddDesignation covers Flick; BasicWorker fails open).

## P2 — NEEDS COMPLETENESS ✅ BUILT (pass 29, in NeedsPatches.cs)
10. **Scheduled drugs** — postfix JobGiver_TakeDrugsForDrugPolicy: due policy drug + empty local result → probe linked levels (vanilla validator: unforbidden/reservable/socially proper; cheap ThingsOfDef existence pre-gate) → hop; giver re-fires and ingests on arrival. DrugNext cooldown.
11. **Patient self-bedding** — postfix JobGiver_PatientGoToBed: vanilla guard chain re-run exactly (urgentOnly, ShouldSeekMedicalRest, timetable-with-surgery/tend exception, disturbance); downed excluded (rescue bridge owns crawlers); probe FindBedFor(pawn,pawn,noSocial) virtually → hop. PatientBedNext cooldown.
12. **Deathrest** — postfix JobGiver_GetDeathrest: vanilla NEVER returns null (ground-sleep fallback) → bridge keys off "targets a cell, not a bed"; assigned casket anywhere in column routes one-hop-at-a-time (owned-bed pattern, GroundMap identity check), else virtual FindBedFor probe (any bed beats ground-sleep, casket preferred by vanilla's own finder). Biotech-gated; mental/roped guards mirrored. DeathrestNext cooldown.

## P3 — DLC DOERS (next)
13. Anomaly entity transport (capture-shaped). 14. Children learning/school. 15. Throne/Reign. 16. Mech repair/gestation verify. 17. Anima linking audit.

## P4 — VERIFY-ONLY (test session, build only if red)
18. Crafter bench pull (cadence fixed pass 28) · 19. research · 20. refuel doer · 21. warden flows · 22. corpse→grave ferry · 23. snow · 24. taming/training/milking/shearing · 25. plant work/blight · 26. repair/deconstruct/smooth · 27. prisoner escape routing.

## OPEN QUESTIONS / OPTIONAL
Animal area-driven migration · guard-trip LETTER · cross-level "take to specific storage" · level-suffixed storage-group names · mechanitor-recipe warning edge.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (verification backlog now spans passes 24-29 — run before P3)
0. Ferry round-2 (crafter continuation, merge-case arrivals, no stair-top piles, mech arrivals).
0b. P0: high-skill bill w/ crafter on another level (no dialog); stove/defenses/rec room elsewhere (no false alerts).
0c. P1: fire on another level w/ busy top-priority firefighter (response at job end); scheduled surgery w/ busy surgeon; new bill starts ferries immediately.
0d. P2: scheduled drug stored on another level (dose taken); sick colonist walks to hospital level; sanguophage reaches casket level instead of ground-deathresting.
1. Below-level lighting. 2. Animal flow + direct-to-blueprint. 3. BAM/Batch B/C. 4. Perf smoke, CE-absent, translation audit, soak, publishing. 5. P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED, mech-inclusive) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry stack (full discipline) · below-level lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · demand fixes · P0 UI truth · P1 emergency responsiveness · **P2 needs completeness (drugs, patient bedding, deathrest)** · BAM compat · perf pass · Batch A verified · Batch B/C pending. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers.

## Compat

Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded · WVC: virtual-dispatch safe.

## Status
2026-07-25 (29th pass): **P2 built green — scheduled-drug, patient-bedding, and deathrest bridges following the house needs-bridge doctrine.** Verification backlog spans passes 24-29; recommend a session before P3.
